posts.text: Yes it does.  Having a mortgage has no bearing on receiving the homestead exemption.

The FL Legislature passed a new congressional map that was sensible, thorough and justified in wake of changes in federal redistricting jurisprudence.  

It is not surprising that claims to the contrary have been rejected in court.

Local governments took in $32 billion in revenue from property taxes in 2019.

Today, that number is $60 billion.

Were services “collapsed” in 2019 when it was $32 billion?

OK, account for population growth and inflation in the ensuing years.  Still doesn’t get you anywhere near $60 billion.

There is no “collapse” in public services by phasing in an elimination of homestead property taxes, especially when starting the exemption at $250,000.


Vexly (@vexlyz)

Homestead tax wipe? Bold. Now fun

And that historic reduction is just the opening salvo.


Kyle Lamb (@kylamb8)

In 2025, the median value of a homestead property in Florida is ~338,000. With a current homestead exemption of $51,411, at 17 mills that same property would owe $4,872 annually. With a $250,000 exemption, the tax is reduced to $1,496. That's a 69% tax reduction at median value.



— https://nitter.net/kylamb8/status/2059751625355395296#m

Save Our Homes.  

Eliminate taxes on the homesteads of Florida residents!  

Special session on Monday to place in on the ballot.


Ron DeSantis (@GovRonDeSantis)

Today in Tampa, I outlined the Save Our Homes from Excessive Property Taxes plan that will eliminate taxes on homesteads. 

Property tax revenue collected by local governments has nearly doubled in the past seven years (from $32 billion to $60 billion) and is expected to reach an astounding $83 billion by 2032.

The budget for the current fiscal year spends less than the budget from the previous year, and that previous year’s budget spends less than the year before.

Four straight years of spending reductions!

Make merit great again!


Neetu Arnold (@neetu_arnold)

“We now observe preparation gaps so severe that instructors must reteach middle school mathematics”
